covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Sheffield Station and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Sheffield Supertram
partial.detail: On the catalog, but the tram operator has no confirmed public live-times feed since changing hands in 2024 — its stops aren't offered in the station picker or Near me for now, rather than being selectable and then showing an error. They stay on file for when a confirmed feed exists.

stations: 18 stations and stops. Sheffield Station's rail platforms and the tram viaduct are shown as two separate entries.
